item_short_desc: Rothco’s 18 Inch D-Handle Sawback Machete is a versatile tool for outdoor cutting and clearing tasks. Featuring an 18 inch steel blade with a sawback edge, this machete is designed to handle tough vegetation with ease. The durable ABS plastic D-style handle provides a secure grip, while the included lanyard adds safety during use. Measuring a total of 24 inch in length, the machete comes with a black polyester sheath featuring a belt loop and thumb snap for easy storage and transport.
